focal_entities.audience: whoever maintains the tool, a person or an AI, and the user reading the pull request

goal_orientation.purpose: seeing on each push that the tests pass on macOS and Linux, and keeping the pinned versions current

goal_orientation.serves: AC7: AC1 to AC6 and AC8 to AC10 each hold on both macOS and Linux, shown on the pull request by the tool's tests, which GitHub Actions runs on both on every push.

constraints.chosen: the tool and its tests handed as organize-downloads: the workflow installs and runs them

the failure handed: GitHub Actions run 40407400092 failed on every job before any step with 'The actions actions/checkout@v7 and actions/setup-python@v7 are not allowed in lovaizu/playground because all actions must be pinned to a full-length commit SHA.'

constraints.decision: Keeping the pinned versions current: Nothing is added to update the pinned actions: whoever maintains the tool updates each SHA and its version comment by hand when they choose; no Dependabot settings file is added.
